theorem PEqualNP.Outside.L_meta_1898 :
∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 → (∀ (x3 x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x3 = x4 ∨ x3 = x4 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x3 = x4 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x3 = x4 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ)) x1 fun (x6 : Fin ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ))) => Decidable.decide (x6 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x3 ∨ x6 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x4)) = Bool.true) → (∀ (x4 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), (∀ x5 ∉ x4, ∃ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (∀ x8 ∈ x4, ¬(x8 = x7 ∨ x8 = x7 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x8 = x7 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x8 = x7 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)))) ∧ (x5 = x7 ∨ x5 = x7 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x5 = x7 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x5 = x7 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)))) → ((¬∃ (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ x7 ∈ x4, x7 = x6 ∨ x7 = x6 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x7 = x6 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x7 = x6 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))) ∧ ¬∃ (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (∀ x8 ∈ x4, ¬(x8 = x7 ∨ x8 = x7 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x8 = x7 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x8 = x7 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)))) → x6 = x7 ∨ x6 = x7 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x6 = x7 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x6 = x7 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ)) x1 fun (x7 : Fin ((13 : ℕ) + (13 : ℕ))) => Decidable.decide ((∃ x8 ∈ x4, x7 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x8) ∨ ∃ (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x7 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x8 ∧ ∀ x9 ∈ x4, ¬(x9 = x8 ∨ x9 = x8 + (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x9 = x8 + (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) ∨ x9 = x8 + (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))))) = Bool.false) → (13 : ℕ) ≤ {x5 : Fin x1.gates.length | (x1.gates.get x5).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and}.ncard
hypotheses: All 52 difference-incidence minimal true pairs evaluate true
Specified closure-qualified independent negative rows evaluate false
conclusion: At least 13 actual ordinary AND-gate indices
mathematical_application: Full difference-incidence correctness satisfies every required positive and negative test, regardless of the additional negative-row qualifiers.
Relabel only primary line inputs by l maps to -l modulo 13; all gate records, gate operations and AND-gate count are unchanged. Hence the same lower bound applies to the full sum-incidence function.

The free-OR decoder expands each operand subset into OR gates and creates at most one ordinary AND per record; false folding, aliasing and dead-gate pruning cannot increase that count. Therefore every K=12 full-plane query is impossible under this existing theorem.
not_claimed: No new Lean proof or compilation was performed for this audit.
This is not a 64-total-gate lower bound and does not settle the posted L-meta-2056 existential statement.
No SAT solver UNSAT certificate is claimed; the K=12 search was superseded by an existing theorem.
K=16 bounded-membership and general 63-gate searches are not ruled out.
